description: Blending classic lantern aesthetics with ultra-modern technology, the Rugged Muse Portable Lamp from Tala is a durable, weather-resistant (IP44) portable light designed for both indoor and outdoor use. Featuring a cordless long-life battery (up to 24 hours), Dim to Warm LED technology, and a custom integrated rotary dimmer, this lamp is sustainably designed to be fully repairable. The Rugged Muse is perfect for nurseries, bedside tables, patios, and anywhere you need warm, portable light. USB-C rechargeable with a built-in handle for easy portability. Materials: powder-coated aluminum, brass, borosilicate glass. Includes 6W E27 dimmable LED bulb (2000-2800K, 500lm).
